final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.transref, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.instownpct) AS avg_inst FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref COLLATE BINARY = t.transreg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist), step2 AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(avg_inst) AS type_avg FROM step1 GROUP BY ordertypedist), step3 AS (SELECT step1.transref, step1.ordertypedist, step1.avg_inst, CAST(step1.avg_inst AS REAL) / step2.type_avg AS ratio FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step1.ordertypedist COLLATE BINARY = step2.ordertypedist COLLATE BINARY), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_inst) AS overall_avg FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.avg_inst, step3.ratio, step3.avg_inst - step4.overall_avg AS excess FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4 WHERE step4.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND step3.avg_inst > step4.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_inst), AVG(ratio), AVG(excess) FROM step5
